summary: Only a plain Pi Zero 2 W box (base + lid, 76.5x41.4x18.5, two USB openings in rear wall). No fan, OLED, encoder, fan posts, vents, window, encoder hole or snap hooks; layout.json lists only the Pi.

defects.what: only rpi_zero2w declared (unplaced list non-empty); fan_40x40x10, oled_ssd1306_096, encoder_ec11 and screws absent
defects.expected: all four catalogue parts + screws declared

defects.what: no fan posts, no fan; lid is a plain plate at z 6.5..11.0; only 8.6-0 = 8.6 mm interior height above floor, no room for fan with 5 mm air gaps
defects.expected: 4 posts at 32 mm pitch, 5+10+5 mm stack above Pi

defects.what: no vent slots; no air path
defects.expected: intake >=300 mm2 and exhaust >=300 mm2 on >=2 walls each
window 26-29 x 15-22 mm centred on OLED

defects.what: no OLED screw posts or pin posts
no snap hooks or catch recesses; lid held only by 4 M3 corner bosses
defects.expected: 4-8 hooks, >=2 on each of 2 opposite walls

defects.what: two USB openings present, 10.8x7.8 around 10x7 plug, 0.4/side, ligament 1.8 -- these pass
